storage: Keep in an airtight tin or zip pouch at room temperature, away from damp; re-crisp in a dry pan or microwave 30 to 40 sec (dish 83 tip) if it softens.
looksLike: Tiny, white, very light and hollow puffs of rice that crunch and go soft quickly in moisture. Sold plain or salted; the plain kind is used for bhel.
howToPick: Choose white, dry, light puffs that snap crisply. Avoid damp, chewy, yellowish or unusually bright-white puffs; a consumer-health page seen in search results warned that urea or bleaching agents are sometimes used to make puffed rice look very white in the Indian market (the page was not opened in full, so treat as a caution only).
shelfLife: A few months sealed per typical pack labels (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run), but it softens within hours once the pack is open in humid weather.

usedIn.raw: 25 g per serving (about 2½ cups loosely packed); the Jain swap that drops the potato may add 10 g more puffed rice
